1) SOC 2: Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report? If so, can you share the report or an executive summary and the date it was issued?

3) Data retention & deletion: What are your default retention windows for request data, embeddings, and model prompt/response content? What is the SLA for permanent deletion after a deletion request or contract termination?
4) Backups & logs: How long are backups retained, are backups included in deletion SLAs, and what is your log retention (access logs, audit logs, billing logs)?
5) Vendor questionnaire: We typically send an RFI / vendor security questionnaire (attached). Can you confirm the best contact to complete it and an estimate for turnaround?

Alex — thanks for the clear list and for sending the RFI. Quick recap and answers below; linking a couple of short docs as well. I copied Neha (Security) and Rishi (sales lead) for follow-up.

High level:
- SOC 2: Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II certified (report issued Nov 2025). We can share the SOC 2 report under an NDA or via our security portal link.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR controls and can sign a BAA for HIPAA-covered use cases. We have data subject request processes documented.

Data retention (hosted API default):
- Request payloads & generated content: retained for 30 days by default for troubleshooting and quality monitoring; configurable for enterprise customers (can be reduced or disabled).
- Embeddings: treated like request data; retained 30 days by default unless you elect a no-retention setting.
- Logs: short-term access logs retained 90 days; audit logs (for enterprise) retained 365 days by default. Billing logs retained up to 24 months for invoicing and chargebacks.
- Backups: snapshot backups retained 180 days by default. Backups are encrypted at rest.

Deletion SLA (general guidance):
- Data deletion from primary stores: initiated within 30 days of request and completed within that window in the hosted environment.
- Backups and snapshots: removed/overwritten within 90 days of the deletion request.
- Permanent deletion confirmation: we provide a confirmation when primary data is removed and again when backups are expired/overwritten.

For Dedicated/Private deployments we provide tighter SLAs and can support customer-managed KMS and custom retention policies in contract.

Attachments: SOC2_System_Description.pdf, Data_Retention_Summary.pdf
Link: https://security.redwood.ai/portal/security-docs

Next steps: 1) Neha — can you review the RFI and confirm coverage/answers for the attached spreadsheet? 2) Alex — if you share the specific RFI fields you care most about, we’ll prioritize those.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Alex — Neha here (Security Ops). Happy to run through details and take the RFI ownership. Answers below (short form) and I’ll populate the spreadsheet you attached.

1) 30-day deletion SLA scope: 
- Primary stores (request payloads, embeddings, model responses): removed from primary systems within 30 days.
- Derived analytics: aggregated/anonymous telemetry used for platform quality is kept separately and can be excluded on request; PII or customer-specific derived datasets are removed per the same 30-day policy if they’re directly tied to the customer.

2) Backups & KMS: 
- Hosted: backups are encrypted at rest using provider-managed KMS by default; we offer Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments so customers can use their own KMS/HSM.
- Backups retention: default 180 days; we will schedule removal/rotation so that data expires within 90 days of a deletion request (i.e., no restore will reintroduce wiped customer data after that window).

3) Logs: 
- Access logs: API request logs retained 90 days by default; exportable via our console/CSV.
- Audit logs (admin actions, role changes, key management events): retained 365 days for enterprise customers and are searchable/exportable via the console or via log export APIs.
- Billing logs: retained up to 24 months for invoicing and dispute resolution.

4) SOC 2 report & RFI turnaround: 
- We can share the SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_Report_2025.pdf) via our security portal under an NDA.
- RFI point-of-contact: me (neha@redwood.ai). Estimated turnaround: 3-5 business days for a standard vendor questionnaire; faster on prioritized fields.

5) Additional notes on deletion confirmations: we issue a deletion ticket with timestamps for primary deletion and a follow-up confirmation when backups/archives pass their retention window. For Dedicated/Private we can contract for shorter backup hold times and custom deletion SLAs.

I’ll attach the SOC2 report to the portal link and start filling the RFI sheet you provided. If you want a call this week to walk procurement through the answers, I’m available Thursday afternoon.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
